State of Maharashtra ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Office notes, Office Memoranda of Coram, appearances, Court's orders Court's or Judge's Ord or directions and Registrar's orders. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Mr.U.Y.Konkusare, counsel for the applicant. Mr.Ashish Kadukar, App for the State. Coram : Mrs. Vrushali V. Joshi, J. Date : 09/12/2025 1. This is an application filed by the applicant for grant of bail in connection with Crime No.599 of 2025 for the offence punishable under Sections 123, 223, 274, 275, 3(5) of Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita read with Sections 26(1)(2) (iv), 27(3)(e), 30(2)(a), 3(1)(zz)(iv) and 59 of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006.
texts.facts: This is an application filed by the applicant for grant of bail in connection with Crime No.599 of 2025 for the offence punishable under Sections 123, 223, 274, 275, 3(5) of Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita read with Sections 26(1)(2) (iv), 27(3)(e), 30(2)(a), 3(1)(zz)(iv) and 59 of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006. 2. On receiving the secret information that the huge quantity of contraband articles i.e. scented tobacco was been transported. Accordingly, the non-applicant intercepted the vehicle No.MH-40-BL-6941 between 3:50 am to 4:40 am on 10.10.2025. On being asked by the Non-Applicant, the present applicant gave evasive answers and informed that, Kavita 2/4 46-ba 11263-25 the said Truck was transporting Vegetables. On the search of the vehicle, the contraband article i.e. packets of scented tobacco was found hidden behind the vegetables. The Non- Applicant then conducted the spot and seizure panchanama and it was found that, the applicant was transporting about 178.285 kg of scented tobacco worth Rs.2,35,751/- . Considering the act of the applicant prayed to reject the application. 5. Heard both the sides and perused the record. 6. Raid was conducted and the vehicle was found which was driven by this applicant. This applicant was taken in custody on the spot. Considering the nature of the offence and as Kavita 3/4 46-ba 11263-25 nothing is to be recovered, the application needs to be allowed.

As the tobacco is seized further custody of this applicant is not necessary, hence prayed to release him on bail. 4.
